definition_zh: 因此；从而；如此；这样
definition_en: as a result or consequence; in this way or manner
core_image: 断掉的桥与绕行的旧河道，两条线合成一条必经的路
scene: 暴雨把山道冲断，车队只能改走河谷里的旧路。The mountain road was washed out; thus, the convoy took the old valley route.
sceneCN: 这里取第 1 个义项（因此、所以，表结果）；句意为山道被冲毁，因此车队改走了河谷旧路。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加副词词尾构成的诙谐或非正式变体，义为「如此」
由本词与表示「远、至此」的词构成的固定短语，义为「到目前为止」
由本词与表示「多」的词构成的固定短语，义为「就这么多」
由本词与两个指示成分构成的固定短语，义为「如此这般」

senses.title: Introducing a result
senses.definition: used to introduce a result that follows from what was just stated
senses.definitionCN: 用来引出由前面所述自然产生的结果
senses.example: The valve was closed; thus, no steam entered the tank.
senses.exampleCN: 阀门已关闭，因此没有蒸汽进入罐体。
senses.why: The oldest sense of manner turned into a sense of consequence: the way things were left produced the next state.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的方式义转为结果义：事情被弄成那样，下一步状态便随之而来。

senses.title: In this way
senses.definition: in the manner or by the means just described
senses.definitionCN: 以刚刚描述的方式或手段
senses.example: The frame is welded thus, with one bead along each joint.
senses.exampleCN: 框架就是这样焊成的，每条接缝上走一道焊道。
senses.why: Manner is the word's original meaning, and it survives whenever the sentence describes how something is done.
senses.whyCN: 方式是这个词的本义，只要句子在描述事情怎么做，这层意思就还在。

senses.title: Up to this point
senses.definition: used in the fixed phrase thus far to mean up to the present point
senses.definitionCN: 用于固定搭配，表示到现在为止
senses.example: Thus far the trial has produced no side effects.
senses.exampleCN: 到目前为止，这次试验没有产生副作用。
senses.why: The idea of reaching a point produced a phrase for how far matters have gone.
senses.whyCN: 「到达某一点」的想法，发展出表示事情进展到何处的固定搭配。

senses.title: Therefore in academic argument
senses.definition: marking the conclusion drawn from evidence in formal prose
senses.definitionCN: 在正式文字中标示由证据推出的结论
senses.example: The data are consistent; thus the model can be accepted.
senses.exampleCN: 数据彼此一致，因此该模型可以接受。
senses.why: Research writing needs an unmistakable marker for inference, and this adverb supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 研究写作需要一个不含糊的推论标记，这个副词正好提供。

senses.title: Hence in a proof
senses.definition: introducing a step that follows necessarily from the previous line
senses.definitionCN: 引出由上一步必然得出的下一步
senses.example: Every term is divisible by three; thus the sum is divisible by three.
senses.exampleCN: 每一项都能被三整除，因此总和也能被三整除。
senses.why: Mathematics adopted the word because a proof is a chain in which each link follows from the one before.
senses.whyCN: 数学采用这个词，是因为证明就是一条每一环都由前一环导出的链。

senses.title: Accordingly in legal text
senses.definition: in statutes and contracts, marking a legal consequence that follows
senses.definitionCN: 在法规与合同中标示随之而来的法律后果
senses.example: The notice was served late and thus the claim was barred.
senses.exampleCN: 通知送达过晚，因此该项请求被排除。
senses.why: Law states cause and effect precisely, and the adverb marks the second half of that relation.
senses.whyCN: 法律要精确陈述因果，这个副词标记这一关系的后半段。

senses.title: So, in literary narration
senses.definition: in older or literary prose, describing the manner in which something was done
senses.definitionCN: 在较古旧或文学性的文字里，描述某事是怎样做成的
senses.example: He folded the letter thus and pressed the seal into the wax.
senses.exampleCN: 他就这样把信折好，把印章压进蜡里。
senses.why: Narrative keeps the manner sense alive by letting the word point at a gesture as it happens.
senses.whyCN: 叙述文字让这个词指着正在发生的动作，从而让方式义延续下来。

senses.title: So in summary
senses.definition: closing a line of argument by gathering the final point together
senses.definitionCN: 收束一段论证，把最后一点收拢起来
senses.example: Thus we may say that the two methods agree in practice.
senses.exampleCN: 由此可见，这两种方法在实际中是一致的。
senses.why: A closing word needs to sound like a conclusion drawn rather than a new claim, and this adverb does that.
senses.whyCN: 收尾的词听起来要像推出的结论而非新主张，这个副词正好如此。

intro.en: Thus is a native Old English adverb meaning in this way. It has no Latin ancestor; its earlier Germanic origin is reconstructed rather than attested.
intro.cn: 这是英语本土的古英语副词，意为「以这种方式」，没有拉丁语祖先；其更早的日耳曼语来源只有重构形式，缺乏直接文献。

items.en: Þus meant in this way and pointed at the manner of an action.
items.cn: 这个词意为「以这种方式」，指向动作的方式。

items.en: The deeper Germanic form is reconstructed from related adverbs and is not directly attested, so the earlier origin is uncertain.
items.cn: 更早的日耳曼语形式由相关副词重构而来，没有直接文献，因此更早的来源不确定。

items.en: Spelling shifted to the modern shape, and the word kept its manner sense while gaining a result sense.
items.cn: 拼写转为今天的形态，词义在保留方式义的同时发展出结果义。

items.en: Prose began to use it for consequence as well as manner; the exact date of that shift is uncertain.
items.cn: 散文开始用它兼表结果与方式；这一转变的确切年代不确定。

items.en: Mathematics, philosophy and law each adopted the adverb as a fixed sign of consequence.
items.cn: 数学、哲学与法律各自采用这个副词，作为标示结果的固定记号。

items.en: It survives mainly in formal and academic writing, while speech prefers a shorter synonym.
items.cn: 它主要存活于正式与学术写作中，口语更爱用更短的近义说法。

note.en: The first group shares a form or a letter pattern; the second group lists other connectives of consequence.
note.cn: 第一组在形态或字母组合上相近；第二组是其他表示结果的连接词。

entries.definition: A demonstrative with the same opening letters, pointing at what is near.
entries.definitionCN: 开头字母相同的指示词，指向近处的事物。

entries.definition: A plural demonstrative that looks close on the page but means something far.
entries.definitionCN: 拼写看上去相近的复数指示词，意思却指远处的事物。

entries.definition: A humorous or informal adverb built by adding a suffix to the word.
entries.definitionCN: 由本词加词尾构成的诙谐或非正式副词。

entries.definition: A time adverb that also begins with the same letters but marks sequence, not consequence.
entries.definitionCN: 同样以这几个字母开头的副词，但标记时间顺序而非结果。

entries.definition: A noun for a heavy dull sound, close in spelling and sound but unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 指沉闷撞击声的名词，拼写与读音都近，但并无词源关系。

entries.definition: The most explicit connective of consequence, common in formal prose.
entries.definitionCN: 最明确的结果连接词，常见于正式文字。

entries.definition: A formal connective of consequence, often followed by a noun phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 正式的结果连接词，后面常直接跟名词短语。

entries.definition: Marks a result with emphasis on the causal link.
entries.definitionCN: 标记结果，并强调因果联系。

entries.definition: Marks a result that calls for a matching response or arrangement.
entries.definitionCN: 标记结果，并暗示相应采取的行动或安排。

entries.definition: The short everyday connective of result, preferred in speech.
entries.definitionCN: 最短的日常结果连接词，口语中更常用。

normalIntro.en: Thus is the little arrow in formal prose: cause first, result after it, and a manner sense underneath.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是正式文字里的小箭头：原因在前，结果在后，底下还压着一层方式义。

normal.en: Hold your hand out thus: the word can still describe the way a thing is done.
normal.cn: 把手这样伸出去：这个词至今仍能描述一件事怎么做。

normal.en: Read it as a short so: cause, semicolon, result.
normal.cn: 把它读成一个短短的「所以」：原因、分号、结果。

normal.en: Its fixed phrases are thus far and thus much.
normal.cn: 它的固定搭配是表示「至今」与「这么多」的两个短语。

normal.en: In a proof it is the arrow saying the next line must follow.
normal.cn: 在证明里，它是一支箭头，表示下一行必须跟着成立。

normal.en: It has no ending and never changes shape.
normal.cn: 它没有词尾，也从不改变形态。

abstract.en: A word that means both therefore and in this way reminds us that causes and methods are often the same thing.
abstract.cn: 一个词兼表「因此」与「如此」，提醒我们原因与方法常常是一回事。

abstract.en: Formal writing uses it to admit that a step was taken, not merely asserted.
abstract.cn: 正式写作用它来承认某一步是被走出来的，而不只是被宣称的。

abstract.en: The shorter the connective, the more it trusts the reader to follow.
abstract.cn: 连接词越短，就越相信读者能自己跟上。

examples.en: The valve was closed; thus, no steam entered the tank.
examples.cn: 阀门已关闭，因此没有蒸汽进入罐体。

examples.en: The frame is welded thus, with one bead along each joint.
examples.cn: 框架就是这样焊成的，每条接缝上走一道焊道。

examples.en: Thus we may say that the two methods agree in practice.
examples.cn: 由此可见，这两种方法在实际中是一致的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「扎斯」——「扎」住前面的原因，「斯」就是随之而来的结果：因此、如此

root: 古英语本土副词，原义为「以这种方式」，兼指方式与结果；更早的日耳曼语形式仅有重构，来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses split into the two layers the word has always had: manner in one half, consequence in the other, with fixed phrases and formal registers in between.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项分成这个词自古就有的两层：一半是方式，一半是结果，中间夹着固定搭配与正式语体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a broken bridge and the old river road, two lines joined into one necessary route.
core.cn: 核心意象：断掉的桥与绕行的旧河道，两条线合成一条必经的路。

branches.en: THE RESULT: consequence is drawn both in everyday prose and in academic argument.
branches.cn: 结果：日常文字与学术论证中把结论引出。

branches.en: THE MANNER: the word shows how a thing is done, in technical or literary description.
branches.cn: 方式：在技术或文学描写中显示事情如何做成。

branches.en: THE POINT REACHED: a fixed phrase marks how far matters have gone.
branches.cn: 所到的这一步：固定搭配标示事情进展到何处。

branches.en: THE FORMAL CONSEQUENCE: a proof step or a legal effect follows of necessity.
branches.cn: 形式化的后果：证明的一步或法律效果必然随之而来。

branches.en: THE CLOSING WORD: a summary gathers its argument into one last line.
branches.cn: 收束之词：总结把论证收进最后一句。

intro.en: Thus is a native adverb with no affix of its own. The items below show its fixed phrases and the connectives it competes with.
intro.cn: 这是本族副词，本身不带词缀。下列条目展示它的固定搭配，以及与之竞争的连接词。

latinIntro.en: There are no Latin entries: the word descends from Old English and has no Latin or Greek ancestor. The list is left empty on purpose.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁词条：这个词源自古代英语，没有拉丁或希腊语祖先，清单按设计留空。

definition_zh: 票；入场券；车票；罚款单；标签
definition_en: a printed piece of paper or electronic record that lets you enter a place, travel, or shows a fine or a label
core_image: 一张撕开缺口的小纸片：凭它才能进门、上车或领罚单
scene: 检票员站在门口查票。She showed her ticket at the gate and walked onto the platform.
sceneCN: 这里 ticket 是「车票」（第 1 个义项：凭以乘车或入场的凭证）；句意：她在门口出示车票，走上了站台。

pos.zh: 票；入场券；车票；罚款单；标签

derivatives.zh: 动词 ticket 加 -ed，义为「贴了标签的；被开罚单的」
ticket 加 -ing，义为「售票业务；出票系统」

senses.title: A pass to travel or enter
senses.definition: a printed paper or digital record that allows you to travel on a vehicle or enter a place
senses.definitionCN: 允许你乘车或进入某处的纸质或电子凭证
senses.example: I bought a return ticket to Leeds.
senses.exampleCN: 我买了一张去利兹的往返票。
senses.why: The core image is the small paper torn at the gate; entry is granted only when it is shown.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是门口被撕缺口的纸片；只有出示它才被放行。

senses.title: A notice of a fine
senses.definition: an official paper that says you must pay money for breaking a rule, such as illegal parking
senses.definitionCN: 表明你因违规须缴款的官方单据，如违章停车
senses.example: He found a parking ticket under the wiper.
senses.exampleCN: 他发现雨刷下压着一张停车罚单。
senses.why: The same small official paper now records a penalty instead of granting entry.
senses.whyCN: 同一张官方小纸片，记录的不再是准入而是处罚。

senses.title: A label attached to something
senses.definition: a card or tag fastened to an object to show its price, owner, or information
senses.definitionCN: 系在物品上标明价格、归属或信息的卡片
senses.example: The price ticket on the coat was missing.
senses.exampleCN: 那件外套的价格标签不见了。
senses.why: A ticket is by shape a small identifying card, so it naturally names things too.
senses.whyCN: ticket 本形就是小型识别卡片，因而也可用来标记物品。

senses.title: A list of candidates in an election
senses.titleCN: 候选人名单；竞选搭档组合
senses.definition: a list of candidates supported by a party in an election, especially in the United States
senses.definitionCN: 政党在选举中推出的候选人名单，尤见于美国
senses.example: She ran for governor on the Democratic ticket.
senses.exampleCN: 她作为民主党候选人竞选州长。
senses.why: Voters once received a printed slip listing the whole party slate; the slip became the slate.
senses.whyCN: 选民曾拿到印有全党人选的纸条；纸条遂代指名单本身。

senses.title: A recorded request for service or help
senses.definition: a record in a computer system of a problem or request that needs to be dealt with
senses.definitionCN: 计算机系统中记录待处理问题或请求的条目
senses.example: Please open a support ticket for the login bug.
senses.exampleCN: 请为登录故障开一个支持工单。
senses.why: Like the paper slip, the record proves your case exists and must be served in turn.
senses.whyCN: 如同纸质凭条，该记录证明你的诉求存在并须依次处理。

senses.title: To give someone an official fine
senses.definition: to give someone an official notice charging them with an offence such as illegal parking
senses.definitionCN: 给某人开具违章等处罚的正式通知
senses.example: The officer ticketed cars parked by the fire hydrant.
senses.exampleCN: 交警给停在消防栓旁的车开了罚单。
senses.why: The notice itself becomes a verb: to hand someone the slip is to fine them.
senses.whyCN: 单据动词化：把罚单递给谁，就是处罚谁。

senses.title: To label or attach a tag to
senses.definition: to fasten a tag to something, especially luggage or goods, to identify it
senses.definitionCN: 在物品（尤指行李、货物）上系标签以便识别
senses.example: Each suitcase was ticketed for the correct flight.
senses.exampleCN: 每只箱子都系上了对应航班的标签。
senses.why: The identifying card again turns into an action: to card something is to name it.
senses.whyCN: 识别卡片再次转为动作：给物品挂牌即为其命名。

senses.title: Just the ticket: exactly what is needed
senses.definition: used to say that something is exactly what is wanted in the situation
senses.definitionCN: 表示某物恰好是当下所需要的东西
senses.example: A hot bath after the hike was just the ticket.
senses.exampleCN: 远足后洗个热水澡正是所需。
senses.why: The right ticket admits you to the right place; figuratively it admits you to satisfaction.
senses.whyCN: 对的票让你进入对的地方；喻指恰到好处、如愿以偿。

intro.en: Ticket is a clipped form of the French etiquette, itself from the Old French estiquet, a label pinned up, from the Germanic root behind stick: a ticket was originally a note stuck on something.
intro.cn: ticket 是法语 étiquette 的截短形式，其源自古法语 estiquet「钉起的标签」，词根为日耳曼语的 stick 一族：ticket 本义是钉或贴在某物上的小纸条。

items.en: The reconstructed root *stik- meant to pierce or be sharp, the ancestor of stick.
items.cn: 重构词根 *stik- 意为刺入、尖利，是 stick 的祖先。

items.en: Estiquet meant a notice or bill pinned up for people to read.
items.cn: 古法语 estiquet 指钉在墙上供人阅读的告示或单据。

items.en: Etiquette kept the sense of a label, and later of prescribed behaviour, the proper label for conduct.
items.cn: 法语 étiquette 保留「标签」义，后引申为礼仪，即行为的规范标签。

items.en: English shortened the word to ticket, first for official notices and licences.
items.cn: 英语把该词截短为 ticket，最早指官方告示与执照。

items.en: The travel and entry senses grew as printed passes spread.
items.cn: 随着印刷凭证普及，乘车、入场等义项形成。

items.en: Modern English added fines, labels, election lists and service records, all slips of identification.
items.cn: 现代英语又添罚单、标签、候选人名单与工单诸义，皆为识别性单据。

note.en: The first group collects the label family from the same stuck-note root; the second sorts nearby entry words.
note.cn: 第一组是同一「钉贴纸条」词根的标签家族；第二组排列相邻的准入类词。

entries.definition: the French parent word, now meaning polite social behaviour
entries.definitionCN: 法语母词，今指社交礼仪；与 ticket 同源

entries.definition: an adhesive label, built on the same stick root
entries.definitionCN: 不干胶贴纸，同样基于 stick 词根

entries.definition: a pointed post or money risked; spelled alike in part but a different branch
entries.definitionCN: 桩柱或赌注；拼写相近但属另一分支

entries.definition: a document granting entry, often for many visits or longer term
entries.definitionCN: 通行证，常可多次或长期使用

entries.definition: a printed slip giving a discount or the right to something
entries.definitionCN: 给予折扣或换取资格的印刷凭条

entries.definition: a paper proving payment has been made

normalIntro.en: Real links: ticket and etiquette share one root, ticket office, parking ticket, and open a ticket.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：ticket 与 étiquette 同根、ticket office、parking ticket、open a ticket。

normal.en: Ticket comes from etiquette: both were labels once stuck on things.
normal.cn: ticket 源自 étiquette：两者原本都是贴上去的标签。

normal.en: Ticket office is where the small slips change hands.
normal.cn: ticket office 是小纸条易手的地方——售票处。

normal.en: A parking ticket grants you nothing; it bills you instead.
normal.cn: parking ticket 什么也不放行，只向你收费——罚单。

normal.en: Just the ticket: the right slip admits you to exactly what you need.
normal.cn: just the ticket：对的凭条让你恰好得到所需。

normal.en: Open a ticket in IT: your request gets its own numbered slip.
normal.cn: IT 里的 open a ticket：你的请求获得自己的编号凭条——工单。

abstract.en: A ticket is a small paper holding a big permission.
abstract.cn: 票是小小纸片，承载大大权限。

abstract.en: Every gate in life asks for its own slip.
abstract.cn: 人生的每道门都索要自己的凭条。

abstract.en: What once pinned notices to walls now pins names to luggage and fines to windscreens.
abstract.cn: 昔日钉在墙上的告示，如今系上行李、贴上车窗。

examples.en: Tickets for the concert sold out within an hour.
examples.cn: 音乐会门票一小时内售罄。

examples.en: She was ticketed for parking across two spaces.
examples.cn: 她因一辆车占了两个车位被开了罚单。

examples.en: Attach the luggage ticket before you hand in the bag.
examples.cn: 交行李前先系好行李牌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踢啃它」——凭票才能进门，门卫一脚「踢」开不买票、硬「啃」它的人 → ticket 票

root: 法语 étiquette（标签）的截短形，源出古法语 estiquet「钉起的告示」，再上溯日耳曼词根 *stik-「刺、钉」，与 stick 同源；核心义为「钉贴或系挂的小纸片」。

sensesIntro.en: From a stuck-on slip the word spreads to passes, fines, labels, election lists, service records, and then turns into verbs for fining and tagging.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「钉贴的纸条」出发，词义扩展到票证、罚单、标签、竞选名单与工单，进而动词化为开罚单与挂标签。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small slip of paper that identifies, admits, or charges.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张用以识别、放行或记罚的小纸条。

branches.en: The slip grants travel or entry.
branches.cn: 凭条授予出行或入场资格。

branches.en: The same slip records a penalty.
The slip fastened to things becomes a tag.
branches.cn: 系在物上的凭条成了标签。

branches.en: The printed slate of candidates keeps the old paper shape.
branches.cn: 候选人名单保留了旧时纸条之形。

branches.en: Records and verbs grow from fining and tagging.
branches.cn: 工单与动词化由记罚、挂牌生长而来。

intro.en: Ticket is itself a clipped compound; its family gathers words about sticking, pinning and labelling.
intro.cn: ticket 本身是截短复合词；其家族聚集了与钉、贴、标签相关的词。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic, so Latin cognates are absent; related Germanic forms are listed instead.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼语系，无拉丁同源词；下表列出相关日耳曼形式。

items.meaning: a pointed piece of wood; to fix by piercing
items.example: Stick the note on the door.
Dinner etiquette varies by country.
The box carries a fragile sticker.
He drove a stake into the ground.
The ticket office opens at eight.
I got a parking ticket downtown.
items.exampleCN: 我在市中心吃了张罚单。

items.meaningCN: 被贴标签的；被开罚单的
items.example: All bags were ticketed.

items.meaning: the business or system of issuing tickets
items.example: Online ticketing is faster.

definition_zh: 整洁的；整齐的；可观的；（使）整洁；收拾
definition_en: arranged neatly and in order, or to make a place neat and ordered
core_image: 归位的抽屉：每样东西都回到自己的格子里
scene: 客人快到了，她赶紧收拾客厅。She tidied the living room before the guests arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 tidy 是「收拾、整理」（第 4 个义项：使整洁）；句意：客人到之前她整理了客厅。

pos.zh: 整洁的；整齐的；相当大的

derivatives.zh: tidy 加 -ly，义为「整洁地；整齐地」
tidy 加 -ness，义为「整洁；整齐」
加否定前缀 un-，义为「不整洁的；凌乱的」

senses.title: Neat and in good order
senses.definition: arranged with everything in its proper place, with nothing out of order
senses.definitionCN: 一切安排妥当、各归其位，毫无杂乱
senses.example: Her desk is always tidy.
senses.exampleCN: 她的书桌总是很整洁。
senses.why: The core image is the drawer where every object sits in its slot; nothing strays.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是每样东西都待在自己格子里的抽屉；无一游离。

senses.title: Orderly in habits or appearance
senses.definition: showing a habit of keeping things, or oneself, neat and ordered
senses.definitionCN: 表现出保持物品或自身整洁的习惯
senses.example: He is very tidy about his paperwork.
senses.exampleCN: 他整理文件井井有条。
senses.why: If a space can be tidy, the person who keeps it that way takes the word too.
senses.whyCN: 空间可整洁，维持空间的人也顺理成章戴上这顶帽子。

senses.title: A considerable amount
senses.definition: used to describe an amount of money that is pleasantly large
senses.definitionCN: 形容一笔令人满意的巨款
senses.example: She earns a tidy sum from her investments.
senses.exampleCN: 她从投资中赚得一笔可观的钱。
senses.why: A neat pile of money is well stacked and large, like a tidy room well arranged.
senses.whyCN: 码得整齐的一堆钱，如整洁的房间般排布讲究且数量可观。

senses.title: To make a place neat
senses.definition: to put things back in order so that a place becomes neat
senses.definitionCN: 把东西归置整齐，使地方恢复井然
senses.example: The children tidied their bedrooms.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们收拾了自己的卧室。
senses.why: The adjective turns into a verb: to give a room the quality of being tidy.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转为动词：赋予房间「整洁」这一品质。

senses.title: To tidy up: finish small remaining tasks
senses.definition: to deal with the small loose ends that remain at the end of an activity
senses.definitionCN: 处理活动结束后遗留的零星事项
senses.example: Let me tidy up a few details before we publish.
senses.exampleCN: 发布前让我把几个细节收尾。
senses.why: Sweeping the last odds and ends into place completes the ordered picture.
senses.whyCN: 把最后的零碎归位，画面才算完整有序。

senses.title: To tidy away: remove after use
senses.definition: to take away things that have been used and put them where they belong
senses.definitionCN: 把用过的东西拿走并放回原处
senses.example: She tidied away the toys after playtime.
senses.exampleCN: 游戏时间结束后她把玩具收了起来。
senses.why: Restoring each object to its slot is the same motion that keeps a room tidy.
senses.whyCN: 把每件物品送回格子，正是维持整洁的同一个动作。

senses.title: Tidy in result: clean and effective
senses.definition: done neatly and efficiently, without waste or confusion
senses.definitionCN: 做得干净利落、不浪费不含混
senses.example: He gave a tidy account of the whole plan.
senses.exampleCN: 他把整个方案讲得条理分明。
senses.why: Order in space becomes order in thought and action.
senses.whyCN: 空间之序转化为思路与行动之序。

senses.title: A tidy profit or gain
senses.definition: a profit that is satisfyingly large, often after simple effort
senses.definitionCN: 令人满意的大额利润，常指付出不大却收获颇丰
senses.example: They made a tidy profit on the flat.
senses.exampleCN: 那套公寓让他们赚了笔可观的利润。
senses.why: Money stacked as neatly as a tidy room suggests both order and abundance.
senses.whyCN: 钱像整洁的房间一样码放整齐，兼有秩序与充裕之意。

intro.en: Tidy comes from the Old English tide, meaning time or season, plus -y. A tidy state was originally timely, happening at the right moment; order and the right time were once one idea.
intro.cn: tidy 源自古英语 tide「时间、时节」加 -y。tidy 的本义是「适时的、合于时宜的」；秩序与合时原本是同一个概念。

items.en: Tid meant a time or season, the root behind tidings and eventide.
items.cn: 古英语 tid 意为时间、季节，是 tidings、eventide 的词根。

items.en: Tidi meant timely, in good season, done at the proper moment.
items.cn: 中古英语 tidi 意为适时、合于时节。

items.en: The sense shifted to neat and well arranged, as if order kept everything in its right time and place.
items.cn: 词义转为整齐有序，仿佛秩序让万物各得其所、各逢其时。

items.en: The verb to tidy and the sense of a considerable sum appeared.
items.cn: 动词 to tidy 与「可观款项」义在此期出现。

items.en: Modern English keeps tidy for neatness, for sizeable amounts, and for cleaning up.
items.cn: 现代英语中 tidy 兼指整洁、可观数额与收拾整理。

note.en: The first group gathers the time-root family; the second lists near neighbours in neatness.
note.cn: 第一组是「时间」词根家族；第二组列出整洁义上的近邻。

entries.definition: news, from the same old word for time or season
entries.definitionCN: 消息、音讯，与 tidy 同出「时」根

entries.definition: the close of day, evening, built on the same tide root
entries.definitionCN: 黄昏、日暮，同样建立在 tide 词根上

entries.definition: liking order in thought as well as in things
entries.definitionCN: 思想与事物皆求条理的

entries.definition: clean and precisely arranged, often with a hint of skill
entries.definitionCN: 干净且安排精确，常含巧妙之意

entries.definition: arranged according to a system or rule
free of unnecessary objects or detail

normalIntro.en: Real links: tidy from time, tidy up, a tidy sum, and the tidy family of tidings and eventide.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：tidy 源于「时间」、tidy up、a tidy sum、以及 tidings 与 eventide 的同根家族。

normal.en: Tidy grew from tide: things in order arrive at their right time and place.
normal.cn: tidy 由 tide 生长而来：有序之物各逢其时、各归其位。

normal.en: Tidy up covers both rooms and loose ends of work.
normal.cn: tidy up 既指收拾房间，也指收尾零星工作。

normal.en: A tidy sum is money stacked as neatly as a tidy drawer.
normal.cn: a tidy sum 是码得像整洁抽屉一般的钱。

normal.en: Untidy simply adds the no-prefix to undo the order.
normal.cn: untidy 只是加上否定前缀，把秩序撤掉。

normal.en: Tidings and eventide keep the original time meaning alive.
normal.cn: tidings 与 eventide 保留了原本的「时间」义。

abstract.en: Order is time made visible: each thing in the moment and place it belongs.
abstract.cn: 秩序是可见的时间：每样东西在属于它的时刻与位置。

abstract.en: A tidy space quiets the mind that lives in it.
abstract.cn: 整洁的空间安抚栖居其中的头脑。

abstract.en: Putting things back is a small promise kept to your future self.
abstract.cn: 物归原处是对未来的自己许下并兑现的小承诺。

examples.en: Keep your workspace tidy to think clearly.
examples.cn: 保持工作区整洁有助于清晰思考。

examples.en: The twins tidied the kitchen in ten minutes.
examples.cn: 双胞胎十分钟就把厨房收拾好了。

examples.en: The sale brought in a tidy sum.
examples.cn: 这次甩卖进账可观。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抬地」——把东西从地上抬起来放回原处，屋子立刻 tidy 整洁 → tidy 整洁；收拾

root: 古英语 tīd「时间、时节」+ 形容词后缀 -y → 「适时的」→「整齐有序的」；与 tidings「消息」、eventide「黄昏」同源，核心是「各逢其时、各归其位」。

sensesIntro.en: Timely order becomes neat spaces, neat habits, neatly stacked sums, and finally verbs for restoring order.
sensesIntro.cn: 由「适时之序」生出整洁的空间、整洁的习惯、码放齐整的钱款，最终动词化为恢复秩序的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: every object resting in its own slot at its own moment.
core.cn: 核心意象：每样东西在自己的时刻安坐于自己的格子。

branches.en: Order visible in the space around you.
The habit of keeping order becomes a trait.
branches.cn: 维持秩序的习惯沉淀为品性。

branches.en: Neatly stacked money reads as abundance.
branches.cn: 码放齐整的钱读作丰裕。

branches.en: The verb returns things to their slots.
Order extends to loose ends and clear accounts.
branches.cn: 秩序延伸到收尾与条理分明的陈述。

intro.en: Tidy is Germanic; its items show the -y adjective ending and the tidy verb phrases.
intro.cn: tidy 属日耳曼语源；词条展示 -y 形容词词尾与 tidy 动词短语。

latinIntro.en: No Latin cognates exist; the related Germanic formations are listed instead.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁同源词；下表列出相关日耳曼构词。

items.meaning: to make a place neat; to finish loose ends
items.example: Tidy up before you leave.

items.meaning: to remove and store after use
items.example: Tidy away the papers.
The tools were arranged tidily.
The tidiness of the lab impressed visitors.
items.exampleCN: 实验室的整洁令访客印象深刻。

items.example: An untidy heap of clothes lay on the chair.
Glad tidings reached the village.
They walked home at eventide.
The lake freezes each wintertide.

definition_zh: 系；打结；捆扎；束缚；领带；平局；联系
definition_en: to fasten with string or rope, or a band worn round the neck, an equal result, or a bond linking people
core_image: 一根绳绕两圈打结：把东西拴在一起，或拴住一个人
scene: 邮差把包裹放上自行车。He tied the parcel to the rack with a strong cord.
sceneCN: 这里 tie 是「系牢、捆扎」（第 1 个义项：用绳固定）；句意：他用结实的绳子把包裹系上车架。

pos.zh: 系；打结；捆扎；（比分）打成平局
领带；绳索；平局；纽带；联系

derivatives.zh: 加否定前缀 un-，义为「解开；松开」
neck + tie 复合，义为「领带」
tie + up 加连字符，义为「停顿；阻塞；（资金）占压」

senses.title: To fasten with cord or rope
senses.definition: to hold things together or fix them in place by crossing a cord and making a knot
senses.definitionCN: 用绳交叉打结，使物体相连或固定
senses.example: He tied the boat to the post.
senses.exampleCN: 他把小船拴在桩上。
senses.why: The core image is cord looped twice and locked by a knot.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是绳绕两圈、以结锁定。

senses.title: To make a knot
senses.definition: to form a knot in a string, lace, or ribbon
senses.definitionCN: 在绳、鞋带或缎带上打成结
senses.example: Can you tie your shoelaces now?
senses.exampleCN: 你现在会系鞋带了吗？
senses.why: The knot is the lock at the end of the looping motion.
senses.whyCN: 结是绕绳动作终端的锁。

senses.title: To restrict or bind someone
senses.definition: to limit someone's freedom of action, as if held by a rope
senses.definitionCN: 像被绳索拴住般限制某人的行动自由
senses.example: The contract ties her to the firm for three years.
senses.exampleCN: 合同把她拴在这家公司三年。
senses.why: The cord on a parcel becomes a cord on a person; binding is constraint.
senses.whyCN: 捆物的绳变成缚人的绳；捆绑即约束。

senses.title: A band worn round the neck
senses.definition: a long narrow piece of cloth worn round the neck under the collar and knotted at the front
senses.definitionCN: 绕颈打结的窄长布带，穿于衬衫领下
senses.example: He wore a dark grey tie to the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 他面试时系了条深灰领带。
senses.why: It is the same knotting action performed on cloth round the neck.
senses.whyCN: 正是同一打结动作施于颈间布料。

senses.title: An equal result in a game
senses.definition: a result in which two sides have the same score and neither wins
senses.definitionCN: 双方得分相同、均未获胜的结果
senses.example: The match ended in a two-all tie.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛以二比二平局收场。
senses.why: Equal scores are held together as if knotted, neither able to pull ahead.
senses.whyCN: 比分像被绳结拴住，谁也拉不开差距。

senses.title: A strong bond between people
senses.definition: a close connection of love, family, or interest that links people
senses.definitionCN: 将人们连结的亲情、爱情或利益纽带
senses.example: Marriage ties are strong in that community.
senses.exampleCN: 在那个社群里婚姻纽带很牢固。
senses.why: What ties parcels ties people: the knot becomes a bond of the heart.
senses.whyCN: 捆物的绳也拴人心：绳结化作情感纽带。

senses.title: To tie up: occupy or hold fast
senses.definition: to keep someone busy or keep money, lines, or resources fully occupied
senses.definitionCN: 使人无暇分身，或使资金、线路、资源被完全占用
senses.example: The phone lines were tied up all morning.
senses.exampleCN: 电话线路一上午都占线。
senses.why: A thing tied up cannot move or be used elsewhere.
senses.whyCN: 被拴住之物无法挪动，也无法他用。

senses.title: To connect or link ideas or things
senses.definition: to show or create a connection between facts, ideas, or events
senses.definitionCN: 表明或建立事实、想法、事件间的关联
senses.example: The report ties the delay to the strike.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把延误与罢工联系起来。
senses.why: A mental cord is stretched between two facts and knotted fast.
senses.whyCN: 一根无形的绳在两个事实间系紧打结。

intro.en: Tie comes from the Old English tigan, to tie, of Germanic origin. The sense chain runs from fastening with cord, to the knotted neckband, to the bound state of players and people.
intro.cn: tie 源自古英语 tigan「系、绑」，属日耳曼语源。词义链由绳索缚物出发，延伸到打结的颈间饰带，再到选手与人的受缚状态。

items.en: Tigan meant to tie or bind, an ordinary rope action.
items.cn: 古英语 tigan 意为系、绑，是最普通的绳索动作。

items.en: Tien covered fastening bundles, animals and loads.
items.cn: 中古英语 tien 泛指捆束物件、拴系牲口与货物。

items.en: The neckband sense arose as knotted cravats came into fashion.
items.cn: 随着打结的克拉瓦领巾流行，领带义出现。

items.en: The equal-score sense and the bond-between-people sense were established.
items.cn: 平局义与人际纽带义于此期确立。

items.en: Modern English adds the verb senses of restriction, occupation and linking.
items.cn: 现代英语又添束缚、占用与关联诸动词义。

note.en: The first group collects the bind-and-fasten family; the second lists neighbours in equality and bonds.
note.cn: 第一组是「缚、系」家族；第二组列出平局与纽带义的近邻。

entries.definition: a level or row in a structure; spelled and sounded close but from a different root
entries.definitionCN: 层级、一排；拼写读音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a flat piece for roofs or floors; looks close but unrelated
the present participle of tie, with y retained
entries.definitionCN: tie 的现在分词，保留 y

entries.definition: to tie things firmly, often round and round
to close or fix something securely
a game that ends level, said of scores and contests

normalIntro.en: Real links: tie a knot, tie the knot, wear a tie, end in a tie, and untie to undo it all.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：tie a knot、tie the knot、wear a tie、end in a tie，以及解一切之 un-tie。

normal.en: Tie is the rope looped twice and locked.
normal.cn: tie 是绕两圈再锁住的绳。

normal.en: Tie the knot means marriage: two lives knotted together.
normal.cn: tie the knot 意为结婚：两条命被系在一起。

normal.en: A tie on the neck is the same knot in cloth.
normal.cn: 颈上的 tie 是布料上的同一个结。

normal.en: A tie in sport is two scores locked equal.
normal.cn: 赛场上的 tie 是两个比分被锁成相等。

normal.en: Untie reverses the motion, releasing whatever was held.
normal.cn: untie 反转动作，释放被缚之物。

abstract.en: Every bond is a knot tied on purpose.
abstract.cn: 一切纽带都是有意打下的结。

abstract.en: Equal forces hold each other like a square knot.
abstract.cn: 相等的力量如平结般互相牵制。

abstract.en: Freedom is what remains when the last cord is untied.
abstract.cn: 最后一根绳解开后剩下的，就是自由。

examples.en: Tie the tarpaulin down before the wind rises.
examples.cn: 起风前把防水布系牢。

examples.en: They tied three each in the final set.
examples.cn: 决胜盘他们战成三平。

examples.en: Old ties brought the classmates back together.
examples.cn: 旧日情谊让同窗重聚。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太爱」——她「太爱」他，亲手给他系上领带，把两人系在一起 → tie 系；领带；平局

sensesIntro.en: One knotting action spreads to packages, necks, equal scores, human bonds, occupied resources and linked ideas.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个打结动作铺展到包裹、颈间、平分秋色、人际纽带、被占资源与相互关联的观念。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cord looped and knotted so things cannot part.
core.cn: 核心意象：绳被绕紧打结，使物不可分离。

branches.en: Rope work on objects and laces.
branches.cn: 对物与鞋带的绳索功夫。

branches.en: The rope closes round a person.
The knot migrates to cloth at the collar.
Equal scores hold each other like a knot.
Bonds, occupation and links extend the knot inward.
branches.cn: 纽带、占用与关联把结引向内部。

items.example: Untie the dog before the walk.

items.meaning: to fasten tightly; to occupy fully
items.example: They tied up the loading bay for hours.
items.exampleCN: 他们把装卸区占了好几个小时。

items.example: The dates tie in with the diary.
The dress code requires a necktie.

items.meaning: a tie shaped like a bow
items.example: He wore a black bow tie.
The film had many merchandising tie-ins.
items.exampleCN: 这部电影有许多衍生周边。

items.meaning: a rule or round that decides an equal contest
items.example: The tiebreaker went on for twenty points.
items.exampleCN: 决胜局打了二十分才分胜负。

items.meaning: a beam holding rails, American usage
items.example: The workers replaced the cracked railway ties.
items.exampleCN: 工人更换了开裂的枕木。

definition_zh: 紧的；牢固的；紧身的；绷紧的；紧缩的；（时间）紧张的
definition_en: held or fixed firmly so that it cannot move, or fitting closely, or with little room in time or money
core_image: 收紧的绳索与贴身的衣料：没有一丝余隙
scene: 行李在车顶晃动，他停车重新固定。He pulled the straps tight and checked them twice.
sceneCN: 这里 tight 是「拉紧、绷紧」（第 1 个义项：无松弛）；句意：他把带子拉紧并检查了两遍。

pos.zh: 紧的；牢固的；紧身的；紧缩的

derivatives.zh: tight 加 -en，义为「使变紧；拧紧；加强」
tight 加 -ly，义为「紧紧地」
tight 加 -ness，义为「紧；牢固；拮据」
tight + rope 复合，义为「（杂技用的）绷紧的钢丝」

senses.title: Firmly held so it cannot move
senses.definition: fixed or pulled firmly so that there is no looseness or movement
senses.definitionCN: 被固定或拉紧，毫无松脱或晃动
senses.example: Make sure the lid is tight before shaking.
senses.exampleCN: 摇晃前务必确认盖子拧紧了。
senses.why: The core image is cord drawn until no slack remains.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是绳被拉到再无半分松弛。

senses.title: Clothes fitting closely to the body
senses.definition: fitting very closely to the body, without extra room
senses.definitionCN: 紧贴身体，没有多余空间
senses.example: The jacket felt tight across the shoulders.
senses.exampleCN: 这件外套肩部有些紧。
senses.why: Fabric drawn like cord hugs the body with no slack.
senses.whyCN: 布料如绳般收紧，便裹住身体不留余地。

senses.title: Under strict control
senses.definition: controlled firmly, with little freedom or leakage allowed
senses.definitionCN: 受到严格控制，自由或疏漏极少
senses.example: Tight security surrounded the summit.
senses.exampleCN: 峰会四周戒备森严。
senses.why: What is cinched cannot slip; control drawn tight admits nothing.
senses.whyCN: 收紧之物无从滑脱；拉满的控制容不下任何疏漏。

senses.title: With little money
senses.definition: having very little money to spend, or spending as little as possible
senses.definitionCN: 几乎没有可花的钱，或尽量少花钱
senses.example: We are on a tight budget this month.
senses.exampleCN: 这个月我们预算吃紧。
senses.why: Money squeezed like cord leaves no slack for extra spending.
senses.whyCN: 钱被如绳勒紧，花销便没有半点余量。

senses.title: With little time
senses.definition: arranged so that there is very little spare time between events
senses.definitionCN: 安排得几乎没有间隙
senses.example: We have a tight schedule to catch the ferry.
senses.exampleCN: 为赶渡轮，我们的行程排得很紧。
senses.why: Hours packed like a drawn rope leave no gaps.
senses.whyCN: 时间像绷紧的绳一样排满，不留空隙。

senses.title: Close and even in a contest
senses.definition: with opponents so close that the result is hard to predict
senses.definitionCN: 对手之间差距极小，结果难料
senses.example: The election was a tight race to the end.
senses.exampleCN: 这场选举到最后仍难分高下。
senses.why: Two sides pressed against each other like rope pulled from both ends.
senses.whyCN: 双方如两端拉绳，彼此紧贴不分胜负。

senses.title: Close-knit and loyal
senses.definition: describing a group whose members are closely connected and loyal to each other
senses.definitionCN: 形容群体成员关系紧密、彼此忠诚
senses.example: They are a tight team after years together.
senses.exampleCN: 多年磨合后他们是一支很团结的队伍。
senses.why: People bound like cords in a knot cannot easily be pulled apart.
senses.whyCN: 人们如绳结般缠紧，便不易被拆散。

senses.title: Penny-pinching with money
senses.definition: unwilling to spend or lend money
senses.definitionCN: 不愿花钱或借钱
senses.example: He is tight with money and rarely treats anyone.
senses.exampleCN: 他花钱很抠，很少请客。
senses.why: The grip on the purse stays closed, as tight as the knot on a bag.
senses.whyCN: 对钱袋的抓握始终不松，如袋口的死结。

intro.en: Tight comes from the Old Norse thettr, meaning tight and watertight, replacing older English forms. The Germanic root behind it is thik-, to thicken or press close, the same family as thatch.
intro.cn: tight 源自古诺斯语 thettr「紧的、不漏水的」，取代了英语更早的形式。其日耳曼词根为 thik-「使变稠、压紧」，与 thatch 同族。

items.en: The reconstructed root thik- meant to press together or thicken.
items.cn: 重构词根 thik- 意为压合、增稠。

items.en: Thettr described anything drawn firm, including watertight planking.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 thettr 形容任何拉紧之物，包括不漏水的船板。

items.en: English borrowed thight from Norse and it spread through everyday use.
items.cn: 中古英语从诺斯语借入 thight，并在日常使用中铺开。

items.en: Spelling settled as tight, covering firmness of grip, fit and control.
items.cn: 拼写定为 tight，兼指抓握、贴合与控制之紧。

items.en: Modern English added tight budgets, tight schedules and tight races.
items.cn: 现代英语又生预算吃紧、日程紧凑与选情胶着诸义。

note.en: The first group gathers the drawn-firm family; the second lists neighbours in firmness and control.
note.cn: 第一组是「拉紧」家族；第二组列出牢固与控制义的近邻。

entries.definition: a rope stretched tight for walking across at height
entries.definitionCN: 绷紧供高空行走用的钢丝

entries.definition: roof covering pressed close, from the same Germanic root
entries.definitionCN: 茅草屋顶，压紧铺成，与 tight 同根

entries.definition: pulled completely straight, with no slack at all
solid and not yielding when pressed
fitting closely and warmly, often comfortably
loose and not pulled firm, the direct contrast
entries.definitionCN: 松弛的，与 tight 直接相对

normalIntro.en: Real links: hold tight, a tight budget, a tight schedule, tight security, and sleep tight.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：hold tight、tight budget、tight schedule、tight security，以及 sleep tight。

normal.en: Tight is Norse thettr: anything drawn until no slack is left.
normal.cn: tight 出自古诺斯语 thettr：拉到再无松弛之物。

normal.en: Hold tight means grip until nothing can pull you free.
normal.cn: hold tight 意为抓到什么都拽不走你。

normal.en: A tight budget leaves no spare coin, like no spare rope.
normal.cn: tight budget 不留闲钱，如绳不留余头。

normal.en: Sleep tight wishes you a bed tucked as firm as a drawn sheet.
normal.cn: sleep tight 祝你的床铺如拉平的床单般安稳。

normal.en: Tighten adds the verb ending: to draw the rope one notch further.
normal.cn: tighten 加上动词词尾：把绳再拧紧一格。

abstract.en: Firmness is simply distance removed.
abstract.cn: 牢固不过是把余隙清空。

abstract.en: What is drawn tight holds, and what holds may also squeeze.
abstract.cn: 绷紧者能抓住，抓住者也可能勒住。

abstract.en: Scarcity tightens both purses and clocks.
abstract.cn: 匮乏同时勒紧钱袋与时钟。

examples.en: She gripped the rail tight as the bus turned.
examples.cn: 转弯时她紧紧抓住扶手。

examples.en: These shoes are too tight for long walks.
examples.cn: 这双鞋太紧，不适合久走。

examples.en: The new rules tightened control on spending.
examples.cn: 新规收紧了支出管控。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太贴」——衣服「太贴」身、绳「太贴」物，没有一丝松弛 → tight 紧的

root: 古诺斯语 þéttr「紧的、不漏水的」→ 中古英语 thight → tight；上溯日耳曼词根 *þik-「压紧、增稠」，与 thatch「茅草（压紧的屋顶）」同源。

sensesIntro.en: No-slack firmness spreads from lids and clothes to control, money, time, races, teams and purses.
sensesIntro.cn: 「无松弛的牢固」从瓶盖与衣服蔓延到管控、钱财、时间、赛况、团队与钱袋。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rope drawn until the last slack is gone.
core.cn: 核心意象：绳被拉到最后一丝松弛消失。

branches.en: Physical firmness on objects and clothes.
branches.cn: 施于物与衣的物理之紧。

branches.en: Control cinched until nothing slips.
Money and hours squeezed to no slack.
Opponents pressed evenly like a pulled rope.
branches.cn: 对手如拉绳般均势相抵。

branches.en: Group loyalty knotted close; purse strings knotted shut.
branches.cn: 群体之谊结得紧；钱袋之口结得死。

intro.en: Tight forms compounds and verbs freely; the items show the -en verb and the common pairs.
intro.cn: tight 可自由构成复合词与动词；词条展示 -en 动词及常见搭配。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic; no Latin cognates exist.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属日耳曼语源，无拉丁同源词。

items.example: Tighten the screws evenly.

items.meaning: a stretched rope for high walking
items.example: The acrobat crossed the tightrope.
The case is water-tight.
An air-tight alibi held up in court.
items.exampleCN: 无懈可击的不在场证明经得起庭审。

items.meaning: to make rules or performance stricter
items.example: They tightened up on late returns.
items.exampleCN: 他们加强了对逾期归还的管理。

items.example: She held the child tightly.
He felt a tightness in his chest.
A tight-fisted boss never gave bonuses.
items.exampleCN: 吝啬的老板从不发奖金。

definition_zh: 瓦片；瓷砖；地砖；（纸）牌；铺瓦；贴砖
definition_en: a flat thin piece used to cover roofs, walls or floors, or to cover a surface with such pieces
core_image: 一片片平薄的方块，紧密相扣盖住屋顶或地面
scene: 台风过后屋顶漏雨，父亲爬上梯子查看。He lifted a cracked tile and showed it to me.
sceneCN: 这里 tile 是「瓦片」（第 1 个义项：盖屋顶的平薄块材）；句意：他掀起一片碎瓦给我看。

pos.zh: 瓦片；瓷砖；地砖；（麻将等）牌

derivatives.zh: tile 加 -ing，义为「铺砖；铺瓦；（总称）瓷砖」
tile 加 -er，义为「铺瓦工；贴砖工」
roof + tile 复合，义为「屋顶瓦」

senses.title: A flat piece for roofs
senses.definition: a thin curved or flat block of baked clay, slate or concrete used to cover a roof
senses.definitionCN: 陶土、石板或混凝土制成的薄平块，用以覆盖屋顶
senses.example: Wind dislodged several tiles from the roof.
senses.exampleCN: 大风掀掉了屋顶的几片瓦。
senses.why: The core image is thin slabs lapped like scales over a roof frame.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是如鳞片般层层搭叠盖住屋架的薄块。

senses.title: A flat piece for walls or floors
senses.definition: a flat square of ceramic, stone or glass used to cover bathroom walls or floors
senses.definitionCN: 陶瓷、石材或玻璃的方形薄块，用于铺贴浴室墙面或地面
senses.example: The kitchen floor is covered in blue tiles.
senses.exampleCN: 厨房地面铺着蓝瓷砖。
senses.why: The same lapped or grouted squares move indoors from the roof.
senses.whyCN: 同样的方块从屋顶移进室内，以缝勾连。

senses.title: A rectangular piece in some games
senses.definition: a small flat block used in games such as mahjong or dominoes, marked with symbols
senses.definitionCN: 麻将、多米诺等游戏中印有符号的小薄块
senses.example: She drew the winning tile at mahjong.
senses.exampleCN: 她打麻将时摸到了制胜的牌。
senses.why: A small flat marked block behaves like a decorative tile in play.
senses.whyCN: 印着符号的小薄块在游戏中如同一枚可摆弄的瓷砖。

senses.title: To cover a surface with tiles
senses.definition: to cover a roof, wall or floor with tiles fitted edge to edge
senses.definitionCN: 用瓷砖或瓦片边靠边覆盖屋顶、墙面或地面
senses.example: They tiled the shower walls on Saturday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们周六给淋浴间墙面贴了砖。
senses.why: The noun names the covering piece, then the act of assembling it.
senses.whyCN: 名词先指覆盖之块，再指将其拼合的动作。

senses.title: A hat, in old slang
senses.definition: an informal old word for a hat, used in earlier English speech
senses.definitionCN: 旧时口语中对帽子的诙谐称呼
senses.example: He tipped his tile as he entered, said the old novel.
senses.exampleCN: 那本旧小说里写道：他进门时抬了抬帽檐。
senses.why: A hat sits flat on the head as a tile sits on a roof.
senses.whyCN: 帽子平扣头顶，正如瓦片平覆屋顶。

senses.title: Tiled tightly: densely packed
senses.definition: arranged so closely that no gaps remain between the pieces
senses.definitionCN: 排布紧密，块与块之间不留缝隙
senses.example: The map was tiled with tiny photographs.
senses.exampleCN: 整张地图密密铺满了小照片。
senses.why: Tiling is the pattern of perfect packing, the zero-gap arrangement.
senses.whyCN: 铺砖即完美拼合的范式：零空隙的排布。

senses.title: A tiled window or area on screen
senses.definition: a section of a computer screen divided into equal blocks without overlap
senses.definitionCN: 计算机屏幕被分成互不重叠的等块
senses.example: Tile the two documents side by side on screen.
senses.exampleCN: 把两个文档在屏幕上平铺并排。
senses.why: Equal blocks fitted edge to edge copy the mason's wall of tiles.
senses.whyCN: 屏幕等块边靠边拼合，复制了砖工的砖墙。

senses.title: A tile on a phone or app grid
senses.definition: a rectangular icon block on a phone or website start screen that updates with information
senses.definitionCN: 手机或网页起始屏上的矩形图标块，可随信息更新
senses.example: The weather tile shows tomorrow's rain.
senses.exampleCN: 天气磁贴显示明天的雨。
senses.why: The grid block inherits both the shape and the close packing of a tile.
senses.whyCN: 界面磁贴继承了瓷砖的形状与密铺逻辑。

intro.en: Tile comes from the Old English tigele, a roof tile, from the Latin tegula, itself from tegere, to cover. It is a direct Latin loan into Germanic speech: a tile is simply a cover in pieces.
intro.cn: tile 源自古英语 tigele「屋瓦」，借自拉丁语 tegula，后者出自动词 tegere「覆盖」。这是拉丁语进入日耳曼语的直接借词：tile 的本义就是「分块的覆盖物」。

items.en: The reconstructed root (s)teg- meant to cover, as in thatch of Germanic stock.
items.cn: 重构词根 (s)teg- 意为覆盖，与日耳曼语的 thatch 同源。

items.en: Tegula meant a roofing tile, from tegere, to cover.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tegula 指屋瓦，源出 tegere「覆盖」。

items.en: Tigele arrived with Roman roofing craft and settled in English.
items.cn: 古英语 tigele 随罗马屋瓦工艺进入英语。

items.en: Tile spread to wall and floor pieces as glazed squares appeared.
items.cn: 随着釉面方块出现，tile 扩展到墙面与地面块材。

items.en: The gaming sense for dominoes and mahjong blocks was recorded.
items.cn: 多米诺与麻将块的「牌」义见于记载。

items.en: Modern computing reused tile for screen blocks and app grids.
items.cn: 现代计算界面把 tile 用于屏幕分块与应用磁贴。

note.en: The first group gathers the cover-root family; the second lists nearby flat-piece words.
note.cn: 第一组是「覆盖」词根家族；第二组列出相邻的薄片块材词。

entries.definition: roof covering of straw, from the same Indo-European cover root
entries.definitionCN: 茅草屋顶，与 tile 同出「覆盖」词根

entries.definition: to cover and guard, built on the Latin teg- root
entries.definitionCN: 保护，建立于拉丁 teg- 词根

entries.definition: to fasten with cord; spelled close but unrelated
entries.definitionCN: 系、绑；拼写相近而词源无关

entries.definition: a large thick flat piece of stone or concrete
a small roof piece laid in overlapping rows
entries.definitionCN: 层层搭叠的小型屋面板

entries.definition: a block for walls, thicker than a tile

normalIntro.en: Real links: tile from Latin cover, roof tile, ceramic tiles, tile the screen, and the tiler's trade.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：tile 源自拉丁「覆盖」、roof tile、ceramic tiles、tile the screen，以及铺砖工的行当。

normal.en: Tile and protect share one Latin root: to cover.
normal.cn: tile 与 protect 同出拉丁词根：覆盖。

normal.en: Roof tiles lap like scales to shed the rain.
normal.cn: 屋瓦如鳞片搭叠，把雨水卸走。

normal.en: Ceramic tiles leave thin grout lines between blocks.
normal.cn: 瓷砖块间只留细缝勾缝。

normal.en: Tiling a screen means equal blocks with zero overlap.
normal.cn: 平铺屏幕就是等块、零重叠。

normal.en: A tiler is the person who makes the surface whole, piece by piece.
normal.cn: 铺砖工把表面逐块拼成整体。

abstract.en: A whole surface is an agreement among many small squares.
abstract.cn: 完整的表面是许多小方块的彼此约定。

abstract.en: Covering is protection arranged in repeatable pieces.
abstract.cn: 覆盖是以可重复的块材实现的保护。

abstract.en: Order on screens borrows order from the mason's wall.
abstract.cn: 屏幕上的秩序借自砌砖的秩序。

examples.en: The bathroom was retiled in white and green.
examples.cn: 浴室重新铺了白色和绿色瓷砖。

examples.en: A loose tile clattered down into the gutter.
examples.cn: 一片松动的瓦哐当落进檐槽。

examples.en: Dominoes are really just tiles with dots.
examples.cn: 多米诺骨牌其实就是带点的牌块。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踢楼」——瓦片松动会掉下来「踢」到「楼」下的人，快去修 → tile 瓦片；瓷砖

root: 拉丁语 tegere「覆盖」→ tegula「屋瓦」→ 古英语 tigele → tile；与 protect、thatch 同出一源，核心是「成块覆盖」。

sensesIntro.en: The covering piece travels from roofs to floors, to game blocks, to verbs, to screen regions and app icons.
sensesIntro.cn: 这块「覆盖之片」从屋顶走到地面、走进游戏、化为动词，又登上屏幕成为分区与磁贴。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: thin flat blocks lapped or fitted to cover without gaps.
core.cn: 核心意象：薄平块搭叠拼合，无缝覆盖。

branches.en: Roof and room share the same covering piece.
branches.cn: 屋顶与屋内共用同一种覆盖块。

branches.en: The marked block enters play.
The noun becomes the covering action.
The hat sits like a tile; packing reaches zero gaps.
branches.cn: 帽子如瓦平扣；密铺臻于无缝。

branches.en: Screens adopt the grid of tiles.
branches.cn: 屏幕采纳了瓷砖的网格。

intro.en: Tile keeps its Latin cover root visible in protect and type; the items show the trade and compound forms.
intro.cn: tile 的拉丁「覆盖」词根在 protect 等词中清晰可见；词条展示行业词与复合形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin cognates come from tegere, to cover.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同源词出自 tegere「覆盖」。

items.meaning: to cover in front so as to guard
items.example: Walls protect the house.

items.meaning: the Roman roofing tile, the direct ancestor
items.example: Roman tegulae still lie in excavations.
items.exampleCN: 罗马瓦片仍见于发掘现场。

items.example: The tiler finished the hall today.
items.exampleCN: 铺砖工今天完工了门厅。

items.meaning: the covering itself or the work
items.example: The tiling in the pool is new.
A rooftile cracked in the frost.
The floor tiles click under your shoes.

items.meaning: a screen region in a tiled layout
items.example: Drag the file into the right window tile.
He counted the mahjong tiles in his hand.

definition_zh: 直到； till 介词连词；收银台；耕地
definition_en: up to a stated time or event, a money drawer in a shop, or to prepare land for crops
core_image: 一段被填满的时间；一只装钱的抽屉；一张被翻松的土地
scene: 夜班结束，店员清点抽屉里的钱。She counted the cash in the till and closed the shop.
sceneCN: 这里 till 是「收银台、钱柜」（第 3 个义项：放钱的抽屉）；句意：她清点钱柜里的现金后关了店。

derivatives.zh: till 加 -er，义为「耕耘机；耕作者；舵柄」
un- + till 复合，义为「直到」，与 till 同义而更常用

senses.title: Up to a time
senses.definition: up to the moment or point in time mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 直到所提及的时刻为止
senses.example: The shop stays open till nine.
senses.exampleCN: 商店营业到九点。
senses.why: The core image is a stretch of time filled up to its end point.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一段时间被填到终点。

senses.title: Up to an event happens
senses.definition: used before a clause to say that something continues until another event happens
senses.definitionCN: 用于从句前，表示某事持续到另一事件发生
senses.example: Wait till the light turns green.
senses.exampleCN: 等到绿灯再走。
senses.why: The end point becomes an event rather than a clock time.
senses.whyCN: 终点由钟点变为事件。

senses.title: A drawer for money in a shop
senses.definition: a drawer or machine in a shop where money is kept during sales
senses.definitionCN: 商店里存放营业款项的抽屉或设备
senses.example: The till was fifty pounds short.
senses.exampleCN: 钱柜里少了五十镑。
senses.why: A fixed box holds what customers hand over, like time held till its end.
senses.whyCN: 固定的匣子收存顾客交付的钱，如时间被守到终点。

senses.title: To prepare land for crops
senses.definition: to dig, plough and prepare soil so that crops can be planted
senses.definitionCN: 翻耕、平整土地以备播种
senses.example: Farmers tilled the field before the rains.
senses.exampleCN: 农民赶在雨季前耕了地。
senses.why: Another sense of work carried on up to a finished state: soil worked until ready.
senses.whyCN: 同样体现「持续劳作直至完成」：把土耕到可用为止。

senses.title: Tillable land
senses.definition: describing land that can be ploughed and cropped
senses.definitionCN: 形容土地可以翻耕种植
senses.example: Half the valley is tillable ground.
senses.exampleCN: 山谷一半是可耕地。
senses.why: The verb leaves its shape on the land it can act on.
senses.whyCN: 动词把印记留在它所能作用的土地上。

senses.title: To keep a till: manage the cash
senses.definition: to operate or be responsible for the money drawer during a shift
senses.definitionCN: 当班期间负责操作钱柜收款
senses.example: It was her turn to keep the till.
senses.exampleCN: 轮到她当班管钱。
senses.why: The drawer extends to the duty of tending it.
senses.whyCN: 抽屉延伸出照管它的职责。

senses.title: Up to and including a limit
senses.definition: extending as far as a place, number or limit mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 延伸至所提及的地点、数目或限度
senses.example: The queue stretched till the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 队伍一直排到街角。
senses.why: Spatial reach borrows the temporal endpoint idea.
senses.whyCN: 空间尽头借用了时间终点之意。

senses.title: Not till: only after
senses.definition: used with not to stress that something happens only after a certain time or event
senses.definitionCN: 与 not 连用，强调某事在特定时间或事件之后才发生
senses.example: Not till midnight did the noise stop.
senses.exampleCN: 直到午夜喧闹才停。
senses.why: The endpoint is denied until it arrives, so nothing happens before it.
senses.whyCN: 终点到来前一切被否定，事件只能等在终点之后。

intro.en: Till as a time word comes from the Old Norse til, meaning to and until, which English adopted. The farming till is a separate native word from Old English tilian, to labour, and the shop till grew from that idea of a fixed working box.
intro.cn: 表时间的 till 源自古诺斯语 til「到、直到」，为英语所借用。农耕义的 till 是另一个本土词，出自古英语 tilian「劳作」；商店的 till 则由「固定的劳作匣子」生长而来。

items.en: Til meant to or up to, marking goals in space first.
items.cn: 古诺斯语 til 意为「到」，先标空间目标。

items.en: Till spread from space to time and joined until as a doublet.
items.cn: 中古英语 till 由空间扩至时间，与 until 构成同源对词。

items.en: Tilian meant to labour and strive, the native farming word.
items.cn: 古英语 tilian 意为劳作，是本土农耕词。

items.en: Tilling meant ploughing and working the land each spring.
items.cn: 中古英语 tilling 指每年春天犁地劳作。

items.en: The shop till appeared, first as a stump or pillar, then the cash drawer.
items.cn: 商店的 till 出现，先指柜台柱，后指钱抽屉。

items.en: Modern usage keeps all three lines: time, cash, and soil.
items.cn: 现代用法保留三条线：时间、现金与土壤。

note.en: The first group gathers look-alike short words; the second sorts time-limit neighbours.
note.cn: 第一组是形近短词；第二组列出时间限度义的近邻。

entries.definition: the fuller form with un- added, meaning the same for time
entries.definitionCN: 加 un- 的完整形式，时间义相同

entries.definition: the machine or person that tills, also a boat's steering handle
entries.definitionCN: 耕耘机或耕作者；亦指舵柄

entries.definition: a roof or floor block; spelled close but a different word
entries.definitionCN: 瓦片、瓷砖；拼写相近而非同词

entries.definition: as far as a point in time or amount
the machine that records sales and holds money
entries.definitionCN: 记录销售并存放钱款的收银机

entries.definition: to turn over soil with a plough before planting

normalIntro.en: Real links: from morning till night, wait till, the shop till, and tilling the soil.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：from morning till night、wait till、商店钱柜，以及耕地。

normal.en: Till fills time up to its edge: morning till night.
normal.cn: till 把时间填满到尽头：从早到晚。

normal.en: Wait till means hold on until the event lands.
normal.cn: wait till 意为等住，直到事件落地。

normal.en: The shop till is a fixed box that holds the day's money.
normal.cn: 商店 till 是装着当日收入的固定匣子。

normal.en: Tilling is working soil till it is ready for seed.
normal.cn: tilling 是把土耕到能下种为止。

normal.en: Not till flips the gate: nothing before, everything after.
normal.cn: not till 翻转闸门：之前全无，之后才有。

abstract.en: Every till is a boundary you work toward.
abstract.cn: 每个 till 都是你朝之劳作的界碑。

abstract.en: Money waits in a box; time waits at an edge; soil waits under the plough.
abstract.cn: 钱守在匣中，时间停在界上，土卧于犁下。

abstract.en: Until is till wearing a longer coat.
abstract.cn: until 是穿了更长外衣的 till。

examples.en: I waited till the rain stopped.
examples.cn: 我一直等到雨停。

examples.en: The robbers emptied the till in seconds.
examples.cn: 劫匪几秒钟就掏空了钱柜。

examples.en: They tilled the slope into narrow terraces.
examples.cn: 他们把坡地耕成一道道窄梯田。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「提尔」——店员「提」起装钱的「耳」形抽屉，正是 till 收银台 → till 收银台；直到

root: 双词干：一为古诺斯语 til「到、直到」（时间义）；二为古英语 tilian「劳作」（农耕义，钱柜义由此衍生）。两线并存，互不同源。

sensesIntro.en: One till runs time to its edge; the other works soil to readiness and holds cash in a fixed box.
sensesIntro.cn: 一条 till 把时间推到尽头；另一条把土耕到可用、把现金收进固定的匣子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: reaching a fixed endpoint, in time, soil or a cash box.
core.cn: 核心意象：抵达固定的终点——时间之界、可耕之土或收银之匣。

branches.en: Time runs up to a moment or an event.
branches.cn: 时间延续到某刻或某事。

branches.en: The cash box and the duty of minding it.
Soil worked until it is ready.
The endpoint borrowed for space and number.
branches.cn: 终点义借用于空间与数目。

branches.en: Not till gates the start.
branches.cn: not till 把起点拦在终点之后。

intro.en: Till is short and old; its items show the particle uses, the full form, and the farming family.
intro.cn: till 短小而古老；词条展示其小品词用法、完整形式与农耕家族。

latinIntro.en: The two tills are Germanic and Norse; no Latin cognates apply.
latinIntro.cn: 两个 till 分别属日耳曼与诺斯语源，不涉及拉丁同源词。

items.meaning: the longer form of the time word
items.example: Stay until Friday.
Till now we had no complaints.
Spring tilling starts in March.

items.meaning: one who or that which tills; a steering handle
items.example: The tiller broke on the stony field.
The tillable acreage is small.
Not till Sunday will it arrive.

items.meaning: the money drawer of a shop
items.example: Lock the cash till at night.

items.meaning: the paper roll inside a register
items.example: The till roll ran out mid-sale.
items.exampleCN: 收银纸卷卖到一半用完了。

definition_zh: 时间； times 时期；次；倍；时刻
definition_en: what is measured in minutes, hours and years, an occasion, or the number in multiplication
core_image: 一条向前流动的河；一次可数的经历；一个被反复叠加的量
scene: 下午的钟声响起来，他看了一眼表。He checked the time and packed up his tools.
sceneCN: 这里 time 是「时间」（第 1 个义项：以时分年计量的量）；句意：他看了看时间，收拾好工具。

derivatives.zh: time 加 -er，义为「计时器；定时器」
time 加 -ly，义为「及时的；适时的」
time 加 -ing，义为「时机把握；时间安排」

senses.title: What clocks measure
senses.definition: the continuous flow of existence measured in minutes, hours and years
senses.definitionCN: 以时分年计量的连续存在之流
senses.example: We have no time for gossip.
senses.exampleCN: 我们没有时间闲聊。
senses.why: The core image is a river flowing forward that people divide into units.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一条向前流的河，人们把它切分成单位。

senses.title: An occasion
senses.definition: an occasion when something happens, counted as a unit
senses.definitionCN: 某事发生的一次，可计数
senses.example: I met her three times last week.
senses.exampleCN: 上周我见过她三次。
senses.why: Each occurrence is lifted out of the flow like one bucket from a river.
senses.whyCN: 每次发生都像从河中舀出一桶，可从流中取出点数。

senses.title: A multiple in multiplication
senses.definition: used to show how often larger one quantity is than another
senses.definitionCN: 表示一个量是另一个量的多少倍
senses.example: The new bridge is four times longer.
senses.exampleCN: 新桥的长度是旧桥的四倍。
senses.why: Counting occasions extends to counting repeated quantity.
senses.whyCN: 对次数的计数延伸为对倍数的计数。

senses.title: A period, often in the plural
senses.definition: a period in history or in life, especially in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 历史或人生中的一段时期，常用复数
senses.example: Hard times teach people patience.
senses.exampleCN: 艰难的岁月教会人耐心。
senses.why: A stretch of the river becomes a named region of life or history.
senses.whyCN: 河的一段变成生活或历史上有名字的区域。

senses.title: A moment on the clock
senses.definition: a point of day stated in hours and minutes
senses.definitionCN: 以时分表示的一天中的某一点
senses.example: What time does the train leave?
senses.exampleCN: 火车几点开？
senses.why: One point is read off the flowing stream.
senses.whyCN: 从流动的河上读出单独的一点。

senses.title: To schedule or clock an event
senses.definition: to choose when something happens, or to measure how long it takes
senses.definitionCN: 为某事选定时间，或测量其耗时
senses.example: The exam was timed to the minute.
senses.exampleCN: 考试精确到分钟计时。
senses.why: The measurer steps in and fixes a point or a length.
senses.whyCN: 测量者介入，定下一个点或一段长度。

senses.title: Leisure or opportunity
senses.definition: a period available for doing something; the chance or moment that suits an action
senses.definitionCN: 可用于做某事的时间；适合行动的机会
senses.example: There is a time to speak and a time to stay silent.
senses.exampleCN: 有开口的时候，也有沉默的时候。
senses.why: The flow is not only clocked but evaluated as suitable or spare.
senses.whyCN: 河不仅被计时，还被评估为合适或富余。

senses.title: Time it: fixed expressions of the flow
senses.titleCN: 习惯用语中的时间之流
senses.definition: idioms that treat time as a resource, such as time flies or run out of time
senses.definitionCN: 把时间当作资源的习语，如 time flies、run out of time
senses.example: We ran out of time before the vote.
senses.exampleCN: 表决之前我们时间用完了。
senses.why: Language treats the flow as money: spent, saved and lost.
senses.whyCN: 语言把时间之流当作钱财：花掉、省下、失去。

intro.en: Time comes from Old English tima, meaning a limited stretch of duration, related to words for dividing and fitting a season.
intro.cn: time 出自古英语 tima「有限的一段时长」，与表示划分、切合时令的词同族。

items.en: The root carried the idea of a divided portion of duration.
items.cn: 原始日耳曼语词根带有「划分出的一段时长」之意。

items.en: Tima meant a limited stretch of time or season.
items.cn: 古英语 tima 指有限的时间或时令。

items.en: Time spread to occasions and the reading of clocks.
items.cn: 中古英语 time 扩展出次数义与钟点义。

items.en: Times came to mean epochs, as in ancient times.
items.cn: 近代早期 times 开始指时代，如 ancient times。

items.en: The verb to time appeared, first for scheduling, later for stopwatch work.
items.cn: 动词 time 于十七世纪出现，先指安排时间，后用于秒表计时。

items.en: Modern usage spans physics, schedule, counting and idiom.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖物理、日程、计数与习语。

note.en: The first group gathers look-alike rhymes; the second sorts time-flavoured neighbours.
note.cn: 第一组是押韵形近词；第二组列出时间义的近邻。

entries.definition: a sour green fruit or sticky substance for spreading on soil
entries.definitionCN: 酸橙；石灰；拼写相近而非同词

entries.definition: the regular rise and fall of the sea
entries.definitionCN: 潮汐；拼写相近而非同词

entries.definition: a device that measures or marks intervals
a very short point of time
a length of time with a beginning and an end
a particular time when something happens

normalIntro.en: Real links: on time, take your time, hard times, and timing a race.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：on time、take your time、hard times，以及给比赛计时。

normal.en: Time is the river every clock tries to divide.
normal.cn: time 是每座钟都想切分的河。

normal.en: Three times counts occasions like buckets from the stream.
normal.cn: three times 把发生的次数像桶一样数出来。

normal.en: Four times longer turns counting into multiplication.
normal.cn: four times longer 把计数变成乘法倍数。

normal.en: Hard times names a stretch of life's river.
normal.cn: hard times 给人生之河的一段起了名字。

normal.en: Run out of time treats hours like coins in a purse.
normal.cn: run out of time 把小时当作钱袋里的硬币。

abstract.en: Every time is both a flow and a unit you can hold.
abstract.cn: 每个 time 既是流动，也是可握住的单个单位。

abstract.en: Clocks do not make time; they only read it.
abstract.cn: 钟并不制造时间，它们只是读出时间。

abstract.en: To time something is to pin one point of the river.
abstract.cn: 给某事计时，就是把河上一点钉住。

examples.en: She arrived right on time for the ceremony.
examples.cn: 她准时抵达典礼。

examples.en: I have read that book four times.
examples.cn: 那本书我读过四遍。

examples.en: The coaches timed every swimmer with a stopwatch.
examples.cn: 教练用秒表给每位游泳者计时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太慢」——抱怨钟走得太慢，时间(time)还是一样流 → time 时间；次；倍

root: 单一词干：古英语 tima「有限的一段时长」，更早出自日耳曼语表「划分、切合时令」的词根。与 tide（潮汐，原义时间）为远亲。

sensesIntro.en: One time flows as duration; the same word counts occasions, multiples, epochs and fixed points.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个 time 作为时长流动；同一个词还能数次数、算倍数、称时代、定钟点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flowing stream that can be divided, counted and named.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条可切分、可计数、可命名的流动之河。

branches.en: Duration and the spare or suitable stretch of it.
branches.cn: 时长以及其中富余或合适的部分。

branches.en: Counting occasions and multiples.
Named stretches of history or life.
branches.cn: 历史或人生中有名字的段落。

branches.en: Reading and fixing points on the clock.
branches.cn: 读出并定下钟面上的点。

branches.en: Idioms treating time as a resource.

intro.en: Time is a native Germanic stem; its items show compounding and derivation rather than borrowed affixes.
intro.cn: time 是本土日耳曼词干；条目展示复合与派生而非外来词缀。

latinIntro.en: No Latin cognates; time is native Germanic, distinct from Latin tempus.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁同源词；time 属本土日耳曼语源，与拉丁语 tempus 无关。

items.meaning: a plan showing when events happen
items.example: Check the timetable for the next bus.
items.exampleCN: 查一下下一班车的时刻表。

items.meaning: a line showing the order of events
items.example: The timeline runs from 1800 to now.
items.exampleCN: 时间线从 1800 年画到今天。

items.example: Set the timer for ten minutes.
A timely warning saved the crew.

items.meaning: the choice or measure of when to act
items.example: His timing on the jump was perfect.

items.meaningCN: 超越时代的；不受时间影响的
items.example: The melody sounds timeless.
items.exampleCN: 这旋律听起来不因岁月而老。

items.meaning: hours worked beyond the normal schedule
items.example: The match went into overtime.

items.meaning: the whole span of a person's life
items.example: It was the chance of a lifetime.

definition_zh: 锡；锡罐；马口铁罐头
definition_en: a soft silver-white metal, or a metal container with a lid for food
core_image: 一块发白光的软金属；一只带盖的铁皮罐
scene: 厨房架子上排着一排罐头。She opened a tin of tomatoes for the soup.
sceneCN: 这里 tin 是「罐头、铁罐」（第 3 个义项：装食品的金属容器）；句意：她开了一罐番茄做汤。

derivatives.zh: tin 加 -ny，义为「锡制的；声音单薄刺耳的」
tin + foil 复合，义为「锡箔；铝箔」
tin 加 -ed，义为「罐装的」

senses.title: The metal element
senses.definition: a soft silver-white metal used in alloys and coatings
senses.definitionCN: 一种银白色软金属，用于合金与镀层
senses.example: Bronze is copper mixed with tin.
senses.exampleCN: 青铜是铜和锡的合金。
senses.why: The core image is a pale metal that bends without breaking.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是可弯折而不断的浅色金属。

senses.title: Sheet iron coated with tin
senses.definition: thin sheet iron or steel covered with tin to stop rust
senses.definitionCN: 镀锡防锈的薄铁皮或薄钢板
senses.example: Rain drummed on the tin roof.
senses.exampleCN: 雨点敲打铁皮屋顶。
senses.why: The metal's protective job names the coated sheet.
senses.whyCN: 锡的防锈职责命名了镀锡铁皮。

senses.title: A sealed container for food
senses.definition: an airtight metal container with a lid, holding food or drink
senses.definitionCN: 带盖密封、盛放食品饮料的金属容器
senses.example: He bought a tin of peaches.
senses.exampleCN: 他买了一罐桃子罐头。
senses.why: The container is named by the metal it is made from.
senses.whyCN: 容器以制作它的金属命名。

senses.title: A baking or loaf mould
senses.definition: a metal mould used for baking bread, cakes or pies
senses.definitionCN: 烤面包、蛋糕或派用的金属模具
senses.example: Grease the loaf tin before pouring the batter.
senses.exampleCN: 倒面糊之前先给面包模抹油。
senses.why: The same metal shapes the container and the mould.
senses.whyCN: 同一种金属既做容器也做模具。

senses.title: The contents of a tin
senses.definition: the amount or contents of one container
senses.definitionCN: 一罐所装的量或内容
senses.example: Add a tin of chopped tomatoes to the pan.
senses.exampleCN: 往锅里加一罐番茄碎。
senses.why: The vessel extends to what it holds.
senses.whyCN: 容器延伸到它所盛的东西。

senses.title: Cheap or flimsy, of machines or things
senses.definition: describing something cheaply made or sounding thin and metallic
senses.definitionCN: 形容做工廉价，或声音单薄如金属
senses.example: The old car had a tinny engine note.
senses.exampleCN: 那辆旧车引擎声单薄刺耳。
senses.why: The base metal becomes a byword for cheapness.
senses.whyCN: 这种廉价金属成了廉价的代名词。

senses.title: Tin as money-slang
senses.definition: informal use for a cash box or small savings tin
senses.definitionCN: 非正式用法，指钱盒或攒钱罐
senses.example: The holiday money sits in a tin on the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 度假的钱存在架子上的储蓄罐里。
senses.why: A closed metal box keeps coins the way tins keep food.
senses.whyCN: 封闭的铁盒存钱，正如铁罐存食物。

senses.title: Tin plated surfaces and small wares
senses.definition: utensils or small items made of tin or plated with it
senses.definitionCN: 锡制或镀锡的小器皿和物件
senses.example: Antique tin cups lined the dresser.
senses.exampleCN: 梳妆台上摆着一排旧锡杯。
senses.why: The metal names the ware made of it.
senses.whyCN: 金属的名字落在用它做成的器物上。

intro.en: Tin is one of the oldest metal words in English, from Old English tin, shared with Germanic cousins and known to Latin as stannum in alloys.
intro.cn: tin 是英语最古老的金属词之一，出自古英语 tin，与日耳曼诸语同源；拉丁语合金义作 stannum。

items.en: The metal was mined early and the name spread across Germanic tongues.
items.cn: 锡开采极早，其名称在日耳曼诸语中传播。

items.en: Tin named both the metal and things made of it.
items.cn: 古英语 tin 兼指金属与锡器。

items.en: Tin foil and tinsmith appear as crafts of the metal.
items.cn: 中古英语出现 tinfoil 与 tinsmith 等锡工艺词。

items.en: The sealed food tin spread with canning technology.
items.cn: 十八世纪随罐装技术普及密封食品罐。

items.en: A tin came to mean the contents as well as the can.
items.cn: 十九世纪英国用法中 tin 兼指罐中之物。

items.en: Modern British keeps tin where American English prefers can.
items.cn: 现代英式英语保留 tin，美式英语多用 can。

note.en: The first group gathers look-alike short -in words; the second sorts container neighbours.
note.cn: 第一组是 -in 结尾的形近短词；第二组列出容器义的近邻。

entries.definition: a container for rubbish or storage
a small pointed metal fastener
very small in size; spelled close but a different word
entries.definitionCN: 极小的；拼写相近而非同词

entries.definition: the American word for a sealed metal food container
a metal mixed of two or more elements, such as bronze
metal rolled into very thin sheets for wrapping

normalIntro.en: Real links: a tin of soup, tin foil, a baking tin, and a tinny sound.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：一罐汤、锡箔、烤模，以及单薄刺耳的声音。

normal.en: Tin is the pale metal that keeps steel from rust.
normal.cn: tin 是让钢板不生锈的浅色金属。

normal.en: A tin of soup is the can named after its metal.
normal.cn: 一罐汤就是以金属命名的罐头。

normal.en: Tin foil wraps lunch; the name stays even when it is aluminium.
normal.cn: 锡箔包午餐；如今多是铝箔，名字却没变。

normal.en: A baking tin shapes the loaf before the oven does.
normal.cn: 烤模在进烤箱前就定好了面包的形状。

normal.en: A tinny speaker sounds like metal hammered thin.
normal.cn: 劣质喇叭的声音像被锤薄的铁皮。

abstract.en: Every tin guards what is inside from the air.
abstract.cn: 每个罐子都替里面的东西挡住空气。

abstract.en: The cheapest metal earns a name for the humblest things.
abstract.cn: 最便宜的金属为最卑微的器物命名。

abstract.en: A tin box of coins is a pantry for tomorrow.
abstract.cn: 存钱罐是给明天预备的食品柜。

examples.en: She emptied a tin of beans into the pot.
examples.cn: 她把一罐豆子倒进锅里。

examples.en: Bronze replaced pure tin tools long ago.
examples.cn: 青铜早已取代纯锡工具。

examples.en: The wind rattled the tin roof all night.
examples.cn: 风整夜吹得铁皮屋顶作响。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「听」——敲一敲铁皮罐，「听」那空空的回响，正是 tin 罐头 → tin 锡；罐头

root: 单一词干：古英语 tin「锡」，源自原始日耳曼语，与德语 Zinn 同源；拉丁语称合金中的锡为 stannum（stannous 一词之源）。

sensesIntro.en: Tin begins as a pale metal and grows into coated sheets, sealed cans, moulds and a byword for cheapness.
sensesIntro.cn: tin 从浅色金属出发，长成镀锡铁皮、密封罐头、烤模，以及廉价的代名词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pale protective metal shaped into boxes for keeping things.
core.cn: 核心意象：浅色而具保护性的金属，被做成保存东西的匣子。

branches.en: The element itself, soft and silver-white.
Coated sheets and small wares of the metal.
branches.cn: 镀锡铁皮与锡制小器物。

branches.en: The sealed can and what it holds.
The mould that shapes bread and cake.
Cheapness by word, and coins in a box.
branches.cn: 廉价的比喻与盒中硬币。

intro.en: Tin is a native metal stem; its items show compounding and small suffixes.
intro.cn: tin 是本土金属词干；条目展示复合与小后缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin name for tin is stannum; English keeps it only in chemical terms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的锡作 stannum；英语只保留在化学术语中。

items.meaning: made of tin, or thin and metallic in sound
items.example: The radio sounded tinny.

items.meaning: sealed in a can; British for canned
items.example: Tinned fish keeps for years.

items.meaning: thin metal sheet for wrapping food
items.example: Wrap the leftovers in tinfoil.

items.meaning: a tool for cutting open cans
items.example: Where is the tin opener?

items.meaning: a worker who makes things of tin
items.example: The tinsmith made a new lantern.
items.exampleCN: 白铁匠打了一盏新灯笼。

items.example: Line the baking tin with paper.

items.meaning: inability to hear differences in music or language
items.meaningCN: 五音不全；听不出语调差异
items.example: He has a tin ear for poetry.

items.meaning: of tin with a lower valence, in chemistry
items.example: Stannous chloride is a lab reagent.

definition_zh: 极小的；微小的
definition_en: very small in size or amount
core_image: 需要凑近才能看清的一点东西
scene: 婴儿的手指抓住他的指尖。A tiny hand closed around his finger.
sceneCN: 这里 tiny 是「极小的」（第 1 个义项：尺寸非常小）；句意：一只小手握住了他的手指。

derivatives.zh: tiny 加 -ness，义为「微小；极小的性质」
tiny 的韵变口语形式，义为「极小的」

senses.title: Very small in size
senses.definition: extremely small physically, much smaller than usual
senses.definitionCN: 尺寸极小，远小于寻常
senses.example: A tiny spider spun its web in the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 一只小蜘蛛在角落里织网。
senses.why: The core image is something you must lean close to see.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是必须凑近才看得清的东西。

senses.title: Very small in amount or degree
senses.definition: small in quantity, extent or degree
senses.definitionCN: 数量、范围或程度上的少与轻
senses.example: She felt a tiny bit nervous before the speech.
senses.exampleCN: 演讲前她有点儿紧张。
senses.why: Smallness of space extends to smallness of measure and feeling.
senses.whyCN: 空间的小延伸为分量与程度的小。

senses.title: Smaller than others of its kind
senses.definition: of a size below the normal range for its kind, such as clothing or models
senses.definitionCN: 低于同类常规尺寸，如服装、模型
senses.example: The doll wore a tiny coat sewn by hand.
senses.exampleCN: 娃娃穿着手缝的小外套。
senses.why: A copy made small keeps the shape but shrinks the scale.
senses.whyCN: 缩小的复制品保留形状而缩小尺度。

senses.title: Affecting only a few
senses.definition: involving or affecting a very small number of people or things
senses.definitionCN: 涉及或影响极少数人或物
senses.example: Only a tiny minority opposed the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 只有极少数人反对该计划。
senses.why: Counted groups can be as small as measured things.
senses.whyCN: 被计数的群体可以和被度量的东西一样小。

senses.title: Tiny in sound or writing
senses.definition: of writing or sound, very small or faint
senses.definitionCN: 形容字迹极小或声音极微
senses.example: He printed the map in tiny letters.
senses.exampleCN: 他用蝇头小字印制地图。
senses.why: Anything made for small scale borrows the word.
senses.whyCN: 为小尺度而造之物皆可借用此词。

senses.title: Diminutive as a fond label
senses.definition: used affectionately or ironically for someone or something small
senses.definitionCN: 以亲昵或反讽称呼小个子人或物
senses.example: They called the smallest wrestler Tiny.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把最矮小的摔跤手唤作 Tiny。
senses.why: The plain adjective becomes a nickname, sometimes in jest.
senses.whyCN: 普通的形容词变成绰号，有时带戏谑。

senses.title: Tiny compared with a whole
senses.titleCN: 与整体相比微不足道的
senses.definition: negligibly small when set against a larger whole
senses.definitionCN: 与更大的整体相比可忽略不计
senses.example: The island is tiny on the map.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛在地图上小得几乎看不见。
senses.why: Scale is judged against a reference frame.
senses.whyCN: 大小须放在参照系里评判。

senses.title: Growing from tiny beginnings
senses.definition: describing starts, efforts or changes that begin almost invisibly small
senses.definitionCN: 形容几乎不可见的起点、努力或变化
senses.example: The company grew from a tiny workshop.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司由一间小作坊起家。
senses.why: Small at the start implies room to grow.
senses.whyCN: 起点之小暗示成长空间。

intro.en: Tiny appeared in Middle English as tine, perhaps from tiny meaning small in an older sense, boosted by words like teeny and by the rhyme family of mine and thine.
intro.cn: tiny 出现于中古英语，作 tine，来源或与更早表「小」的词有关，并受 teeny 及 mine、thine 韵族影响而定形。

items.en: Tine is first recorded meaning very small.
items.cn: 中古英语 tine 最早见于记载，意为极小。

items.en: The ending -y, as in many and plenty, may have shaped the modern form.
items.cn: 如 many、plenty 中的 -y 词尾可能塑造了现代形式。

items.en: Tiny settled as the everyday word for very small.
items.cn: 十六世纪 tiny 定型为表极小的常用词。

items.en: Tiny house and tiny amounts spread in common speech.
items.cn: 十九世纪 tiny house 与 tiny amounts 在口语中铺开。

items.en: The word now spans size, amount and affectionate nicknames.
items.cn: 现代用法涵盖尺寸、数量与亲昵绰号。

note.en: The first group gathers look-alike rhymes; the second sorts smallness words by shade.
note.cn: 第一组是押韵形近词；第二组按语义层次列出表小的近义词。

entries.definition: bright because it reflects light
informal for extremely small
the metal or a can; spelled close but a different word
entries.definitionCN: 锡；罐头；拼写相近而非同词

entries.definition: extremely small, often in fine detail
so small it needs a microscope
entries.definitionCN: 显微镜下才可见的；极微的

entries.definition: very small indeed, often of amounts

normalIntro.en: Real links: a tiny bit, tiny details, a tiny minority, and a tiny workshop.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：一点点、细微的细节、极少数，以及一间小作坊。

normal.en: A tiny spider is one you almost miss.
normal.cn: tiny 的蜘蛛是你几乎错过的那只。

normal.en: A tiny bit measures feelings as small as space.
normal.cn: a tiny bit 把情感量得像空间一样小。

normal.en: Tiny details hide under the lens of attention.
normal.cn: 细微的细节藏在注意力的镜头下。

normal.en: A tiny minority is small in number, not in voice.
normal.cn: 极少数人数少，声音未必小。

normal.en: The wrestler called Tiny shows irony at work.
normal.cn: 被叫作 Tiny 的摔跤手展示了反讽的用法。

abstract.en: Every tiny thing is a whole world at another scale.
abstract.cn: 每个 tiny 之物都是另一个尺度上的完整世界。

abstract.en: Smallness is always an answer to the question: compared with what?
abstract.cn: 小永远是在回答：与什么相比？

abstract.en: The tiny start is a seed that claims the field.
abstract.cn: 微小的起点是一粒终将占据田野的种子。

examples.en: The watchmaker handled tiny gears with steady hands.
examples.cn: 钟表匠用稳当的手摆弄细小的齿轮。

examples.en: There was only a tiny amount of milk left.
examples.cn: 剩下的牛奶只有一点点。

examples.en: They rented a tiny flat above the bakery.
examples.cn: 他们在面包房楼上租了一间小公寓。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「太迷你」——太迷你就是极小，正是 tiny → tiny 极小的；微小的

root: 单一词干：中古英语 tine「极小」，词尾受 many、plenty 的 -y 影响而定形；属本土日耳曼语层的口语小词，无古典词缀。

sensesIntro.en: Tiny measures space first, then amount, degree, number and even fondness.
sensesIntro.cn: tiny 先量空间，再量数量、程度、人数，甚至量出亲昵。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something so small it demands a closer look.
core.cn: 核心意象：小到必须凑近看的东西。

branches.en: Physical size, real or copied down.
branches.cn: 实物尺寸，或缩小的复本。

branches.en: Small amounts, degrees, letters and sounds.
branches.cn: 小的数量、程度、字迹与声音。

branches.en: Few people, small against a whole.
branches.cn: 人数之少，对整体而言之小。

branches.en: The adjective as a nickname.
Tiny beginnings with room to grow.
branches.cn: 留有成长空间的微末起点。

intro.en: Tiny takes plain English suffixes; its items show degree, noun forms and compounds.
intro.cn: tiny 只接朴素的英语后缀；条目展示程度、名词形式与复合词。

latinIntro.en: Latin offers micro- and mini- as parallel smallness prefixes, not relatives of tiny.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供 micro- 与 mini- 这类表小前缀，但与 tiny 并不同源。

items.meaning: the quality of being very small
items.example: The tininess of the room surprised them.
The second nest was even tinier.
The tiniest error cost the match.
items.exampleCN: 最微小的失误输掉了比赛。

items.meaning: a very small fully functional dwelling
items.example: They built a tiny house by the lake.
items.exampleCN: 他们在湖边建了一座小屋。

items.meaning: a living thing too small to see unaided
items.example: Micro-organisms live in the soil.
The miniskirt defined the decade.
items.exampleCN: 迷你裙定义了那个年代。

items.meaning: to reduce to the smallest possible amount
items.example: Minimize the risks before launch.
items.exampleCN: 发布前把风险降到最低。

items.example: A teeny-weeny button rolled away.

definition_zh: 尖端；小费；顶端；倾倒；给小费
definition_en: the pointed end of something, extra money for service, or to tilt and empty a container
core_image: 一根手指能点住的顶端；桌面一角翘起的倾斜
scene: 笔尖在纸上洇出一小团墨。Ink spread from the tip of his pen.
sceneCN: 这里 tip 是「尖端」（第 1 个义项：物体最细最前的末端）；句意：墨水从他笔尖洇开。

collocations.zh: 使天平倾斜；起决定作用

derivatives.zh: tip 加 -sy，义为「微醉的；站不稳的」（由倾斜义引申）
tip 加 -ster，义为「提供内幕消息者；赛马预测者」
tip + point 复合，义为「临界点；引爆点」

senses.title: The pointed or far end
senses.definition: the thin, pointed or extreme end of something long or sharp
senses.definitionCN: 细长或锐利物体的最末端
senses.example: The pencil broke at the tip.
senses.exampleCN: 铅笔在笔尖处断了。
senses.why: The core image is a point you can touch with one finger.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一根手指就能点住的顶点。

senses.title: A small sum for service
senses.definition: extra money given to someone for a service, beyond the price
senses.definitionCN: 服务价格之外另给的酬金
senses.example: He left a tip for the waiter.
senses.exampleCN: 他给服务员留了小费。
senses.why: Money handed over at the end, like the end of a transaction.
senses.whyCN: 交易末尾递出的钱，如事物之「末端」。

senses.title: A useful hint
senses.definition: a small piece of practical advice or advance information
senses.definitionCN: 一小条实用建议或内幕消息
senses.example: She gave me a tip about the exam.
senses.exampleCN: 她给了我一则关于考试的小提示。
senses.why: A small item that tilts your understanding or plans.
senses.whyCN: 一条小消息让局面为你倾斜。

senses.title: To tilt or overturn
senses.definition: to lean to one side, or to make something fall by tilting it
senses.definitionCN: 侧向一边，或使某物倾覆
senses.example: The boat tipped in the wind.
senses.exampleCN: 小船在风中倾斜。
senses.why: The end swings down as the whole leans.
senses.whyCN: 整体倾斜时，末端先落。

senses.title: To empty by tilting
senses.definition: to pour out the contents of a container by tilting it
senses.definitionCN: 倾斜容器把里面的东西倒出来
senses.example: He tipped the box of nails onto the bench.
senses.exampleCN: 他把一盒钉子倒在长凳上。
senses.why: Tilting leads directly to emptying.
senses.whyCN: 倾斜自然导向倒空。

senses.title: To give a tip of money
senses.definition: to give extra money to a person for a service
